title: Helmlore Marina Price Guide
coverage: Expanded national researched inventory, not a verified exhaustive census. Physical marina/pontoon facilities; annual availability and price verification vary. Visitor-only facilities are explicitly excluded from annual ranking.
price_basis: Published annual berth tariff + confirmed compulsory fees + VAT where known. Electricity, licences, access, availability and unlisted charges require confirmation.
currency_policy: GBP and EUR shown separately; no exchange-rate conversion applied.

records.name: Plymouth Yacht Haven
records.notes: Standard pontoon berths; harbour dues included. Metered electricity extra. Multihull supplement may apply. Heavy vessel over 60 tonnes surcharge £1,500 plus VAT. Restricted-access max 8 m alternative £482/m must be separately flagged; 14–14.1 m tariff gap requires quote.

availability.evidence: Annual berth availability not confirmed; contact marina. A published price does not establish a vacancy.
